events.headline: WTI crude plunges ~4.25% to ~$92/bbl after Trump signals openness to meeting Iran's President Pezeshkian at the UN, unwinding war-risk premium built up over the 2026 Iran war/Strait of Hormuz crisis
Honeywell and Kratos announced cruise-missile propulsion milestones amid high global demand to replenish depleted defense stockpiles

China's export licensing controls on seven medium/heavy rare earths (samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium, yttrium) remain in force; non-Chinese dysprosium/terbium trading at large multiples of Chinese reference prices, with the broader Oct-2025 control package's one-year suspension set to expire Nov 10, 2026

Fed hiked its benchmark rate 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16 in a unanimous 12-0 vote, the first hike in 3+ years, citing elevated inflation (core PCE 3.3% in July); 16 of 18 officials see another hike this year
Korean chip stocks (Samsung, SK Hynix) gained as Meta's Muse AI agent spurred enthusiasm across the AI/semiconductor supply chain, though broader AI/chip momentum was cooling into Tuesday's session
